principal_result: REFUTED—EXACT: unrestricted cross-scale pooling of all selected seed birth runs into uniformly bounded original-KEEP-radius first-hit A windows.
parametric_quantifiers: For every finite load C and fixed integer radius ell>=0, choose integer h>C and pad ell+1 identity KEEPs on each side of the common first hit. The complete original W_(h,ell,Y) contains h distinct eligible seed birth runs but exactly one real A cost unit in their union of permitted windows.
same_source_scales: One W has n=12*2^h-3 throughout. Its stages use d_i=i,r_i=12*2^(h-i)-3,p_i=1,q_i=3*2^(h-i)-2. No switch of sources, carriers or ambient support is made between stages.
arbitrary_interleaving_lemma: After the p=1 critical prefix, all odd base vertices below r-2 are protected leaves. F={2,4,...,r-3,r-2,r-1,r} is an actual rooted free hull. Arbitrary original KEEP traffic on F preserves those full subtrees; the final full decreasing F scan yields the exact full T_((r-3)/2,d+1).
selected_stack: a=2^(h+1)+1, x=a+1; L_i=[a,a+2^(i+1)-2], size2^(i+1)-1. Original maximum bit0 step(r_i-g_i)/2, g_i=2^(h+1-i)+1, creates L_i. All chosen runs survive until common KEEP x.
actual_consumer_obstruction: In copy2, B probe LL whole frames L3,L5,...,L_(2*floor((h-1)/2)+1) are neutral, interior and absent from A over their full original Pi windows. Hence at least floor((h-1)/2) genuine original U_int consumers meet unbounded scale/alignment deficits at that one A gap.

derived_positive_theorem.status: PROVED—RESTRICTED DOMAIN, source-uniform at the precise eligibility below.
derived_positive_theorem.quantity: R_(o,k) is the literal original U_int subset whose whole-frame carrier-rank label is I_(d,j)^o=[o+j*2^(d+1)+1,o+(j+1)*2^(d+1)-1], d>=1, and d-v2(abs(x-o))<=k at its producing KEEP rank x. Origin o is fixed once per source and k is fixed; x=o has no canonical containing interval.
derived_positive_theorem.real_A_load: At most k+1, on bit0 of the first nonzero original A StepEv in each producer KEEP gap.
derived_positive_theorem.domain: All admissible exactly paired-closed original sources with their original static ancestor-closed B carrier S and original literal U_int predicate. Carrier ranks are only measurements; no physical path/node/event is removed. A private ancestors and helpers remain unrestricted.
derived_positive_theorem.proof: A canonical interval of depth d containing x has d>=v2(abs(x-o)). Eligibility leaves only k+1 possible depths. Whole-frame carrier labels strictly increase along the original B splay, so at most one demand at each eligible depth is produced at a KEEP. Distinct original KEEP gaps give disjoint real A representatives.
derived_positive_theorem.birth_corollary: All actual B canonical-label birth runs with first-hit deficit<=k likewise have A load<=k+1 across all sizes, because at a first hit the live labels are nested and at most one exists per eligible depth.
derived_positive_theorem.not_a_one_size_sum: Bound the simultaneous load at each actual A representative over every scale, then sum original KEEP gaps once.
derived_positive_theorem.nonvacuity: The new h>=3 sources contain an actual U whole frame L3 of deficit2. Uniform E inflation shifts both its canonical depth and target valuation by the same amount, producing arbitrarily large covered frames with the same constant3.
